title: Hooray for Hollywood 35-Minute Helicopter Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
It is the company's policy is to verify both credit card used to book + government issued identification. Please be prepared to present these two items prior to your flight.

All bookings: 2 passenger minimum. For 4 or more passengers – Please note that groups will not travel at the same time. Multiple flights will need to occur. Example: 1st group flies, then 2nd group waits and so on.
All flight times are approximate and subject to change due to weather conditions and weight restrictions
All passenger heights and weights must be advised at time of booking

Children: UNDER 24 months of age - not yet reached their 2nd birthday are welcome as a lap child at no charge when there is a minimum of two adults on board. Children 24 months and older require an individual full-fare seat. Per Federal Aviation Administration Regulation 14 CFR 91.205: An approved safety belt with an approved metal-to-metal latching device, or other approved restraint system for each occupant 2 years of age or older.
For safety reasons, the helicopter cannot accommodate any passengers weighing more than 300 pounds (136 kilos) however if any passenger is over 250 lbs please contact operator.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Day or night, there is simply no better way to see the famous sights of Los Angeles than from a helicopter. Soar over the Hollywood Hills on this 35 minute tour and see Sunset Boulevard, Hollywood Boulevard, Beverly Hills, Grauman's Chinese Theatre, and the glistening Downtown skyline from a birds-eye perspective. Depart from Van Nuys Airport, where scenes from 'Casablanca' were shot. Admire the iconic Hollywood Sign as you get up close through panoramic helicopter windows.
